name: Algebraic Number Theory
description:
Algebraic numbers, transcendental numbers, minimal polynomial, conjugates.
Algebraic number fields, primitive element, real and complex embeddings, norm, trace and discriminant.
Algebraic integers, ring of integers in a number field, integral basis.
Examples of quadratic fields, cubic fields, cyclotomic fields.
Dedekind domain, ideal factorization, fractional ideal, ideal class group.
Lattices, Minkowski's theory, finiteness of class group, computation of class group of number fields.
Dirichlet Unit Theorem, fundamental units, units in quadratic fields, solution of Pell's equation.
Extensions of Dedekind domains, Galois extensions, decomposition and inertia groups, ramification
Dedekind zeta function and analytic class number formula (proof of the quadratic class number formula).
